searches.query: Are size 9 waterproof hiking boots available for pickup in my nearest store right now?

chunks.text: Store pickup may be available for an oversize item when the chosen store has stock. A catalog listing alone does not establish that a particular store has it. Do not carry a damaged or unstable load away from a pickup location.

Hiking boot fit trial  Hiking boots bought from the online store have a 60-calendar-day fit trial, measured from delivery. This includes boots worn on ordinary outdoor walks. The purpose is to let customers discover pressure points that may not appear during an indoor fitting. The customer can claim one fit-trial return in any rolling 12-month period. Record the previous claim date before approving another pair.  The trial excludes damage from misuse, missing parts, and boots altered by a third party. Normal trail dust and wear from walking do not by themselves disqualify a pair. Remove loose dirt before packing. The boots must be returned as a complete pair. Boots that satisfy the trial receive a refund of the item price paid; original delivery charges remain nonrefundable.  Start the request in the normal returns portal and select the fit-trial reason. The standard seven-day dispatch deadline after approval still applies. This trial changes the eligibility window and acceptable wear for hiking boots only.

Collecting an online order in a store  Store pickup has no delivery fee when the chosen store has the product available. Wait for the ready-for-collection message before travelling. An order confirmation is not a ready message. The store holds a ready order for five calendar days from the ready message. Contact the store if collection within that period is not possible; the published policy does not guarantee an extension.  Bring the collection reference and identification matching the collecting person registered on the order. A purchaser may nominate another adult in the order portal before collection. A forwarded email alone does not add that person to the collection record. Inspect large items at the store and ask staff for help with loading when needed.  Pickup eligibility and stock are specific to each store. The online product catalog does not establish which store has an item today. The published pickup process cannot answer a live stock question or reserve a product on its own. Product return and warranty windows start from the recorded collection date for a pickup order.

This trial changes the eligibility window and acceptable wear for hiking boots only. It does not change the price of a return label. Read the return-label policy for the applicable fee and the membership policy for any shipping benefits. The fit trial does not promise a particular replacement model will be in stock.

Standard returns for unused gear  The online store accepts ordinary unused gear within 30 calendar days after delivery. Customers must open a return request in the order portal before that window ends. After approval, they have seven calendar days to hand the parcel to the carrier. The request date determines whether the return was opened on time; the carrier acceptance date determines whether the shipping deadline was met.  Keep the original tags attached and include all parts. Trying a jacket on indoors does not count as using it. Washing a garment, taking a sleeping bag camping, or removing a safety seal does count as use. Used products cannot enter the ordinary change-of-mind return process. Hiking boots have a separate fit-trial policy, and damaged products have a separate warranty process. An exception for one product category does not extend the window for other products in the same order.  The warehouse checks the condition before approving the refund. A return request is not itself a refund.

Outlet and final-sale products  Products marked final sale in the outlet cannot be returned merely because the customer changes their mind, chooses the wrong color, or finds a lower price later. The final-sale marking appears on the product page and the order confirmation. A general store promotion does not make a product final sale unless the product is specifically marked that way.  Final sale does not remove the manufacturing warranty. A defective outlet tent follows the tent warranty assessment process, including proof of purchase and photos. Cosmetic wear that was disclosed on the outlet listing is not a new manufacturing defect. Support must distinguish a disclosed condition from a fault that arose later.  If the delivered outlet product does not match the listing, report that problem within 14 calendar days after delivery. Keep photographs of the product and the packaging. The support team checks the listing and the received item before arranging a remedy. The 14-day mismatch report window is a separate route from the manufacturing warranty.
The allocation does not authorize sending fuel through the mail. These pages do not list current store fuel stock, local collection hours, or the availability of a specific canister brand.
Product return and warranty windows start from the recorded collection date for a pickup order. Other eligibility conditions, including final-sale markings and product-specific trials, still apply.

Camping fuel and stove returns  The online store sells empty camping stoves and accessories but does not ship filled fuel canisters. Fuel is sold for store collection only where a store is authorized to stock it. A stove listing does not mean fuel is included. Customers should check the compatible fuel type in the product instructions before buying fuel separately.  Never include a used or full fuel canister in a stove return. Remove any fuel container before arranging an eligible stove return and follow the manufacturer's instructions for making the stove safe. If the stove has leaked or appears unsafe, contact support for the product-specific procedure instead of using an ordinary label.  An unused stove bought online follows the standard return policy unless it was marked final sale. A stove bought as part of the starter kit uses the discounted-bundle allocation for its paid item value. The allocation does not authorize sending fuel through the mail.
